Clca 23 to 36 inches, light brownish gray (2.5Y 6/2) clay loam, light olive brown (2.5Y 5/3) moist; massive structure; hard, friable, sticky and plastic; strongly effervescent; common fine lime threads and a few lime masses; clear wavy boundary.
C2 36 to 44 inches, light yellowish brown (2.5Y 6/3) sandy clay loam, light olive brown (2.5Y 5/3) moist; massive; hard, friable, slightly sticky and plastic; strongly effervescent; gradual wavy boundary.
C3 44 to 60 inches, pale yellow (2.5Y 7/3) silt loam, light olive brown (2.5Y 5/4) moist; massive structure; hard, friable, nonsticky and slightly plastic; strongly effervescent.
The dark surface layer is 7 to 17 inches thick. The solum is 12 to 22 inches thick. Coarse fragment content is typically less than 5 percent and ranges from 0 to 10 percent. The A horizon, 3 to 5 inches thick, has hue of 2.5Y or 10YR chrome of 2 or 3. The color range is grayish brown, dark grayish brown, and brown. The B2t horizon is silty clay or heavy clay loam with clay content ranging from 35 to 45 percent. Color range is olive brown, light olive brown, and brown. The C horizon has color of pale brown, light yellowish brown, and pale yellow. Segregated lime is in films, fine threads and soft masses. Estimated calcium carbonate equivalent is 8 to 12 percent.
Nunn soils are associated with Fort Collings, McRae, and Wages soils. Fort Collins and Wages soils have less than 35 percent clay in the B2t horizon. The McRae soils have lighter color and lack a B2t horizon.
Nunn silty clay loam, 1 to 4 percent slopes (Nn).
This nearly level and gently sloping soil is on fans and terraces in intermittent and perennial stream valleys. Shallow drainageways on the fans give local relief of 1 to 3 feet. The soil has the profile described as typical for the series. On the fans, areas having a silt loam surface were included in mapping this soil.
Surface runoff is slow, and the erosion hazard is slight.
This soil is suited to irrigated and dryland crops. It is also suited to range.
(Capability Unit IIIe-2 Dryland; IIe-1 Irrigated; Clayey range site 10-14 inch precipitation zone; Windbreak Suitability Group 1).
